scenario.description: An HR business partner must decide the appropriate response to a communication complaint involving an employee and finalize the employee's improvement plan, including required communication adjustments, the incident record, a repair meeting, and mentoring support.

shared_context.S1: Avery raised a concern that Morgan's communication during recent team discussions has made collaboration difficult.
shared_context.S2: Dana must decide the formal response and record the resulting improvement plan.
shared_context.S3: The concern has not yet resulted in a written warning or other formal discipline.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing, Dana holds a structured case review in which Morgan, Avery, and Lee each give their factual account and identify any support or follow-up they believe is needed.
shared_context.S5: The case-review protocol requires each participant's factual account and requested follow-up to be entered into the case record.
shared_context.S6: Dana's case-record form requires the reason for each plan element and any supporting workplace documentation to be recorded before the plan is finalized.

PF1.text: Morgan has an approved workplace accommodation stating that communication-related concerns must begin with a 30-day developmental coaching plan, with written agendas provided at least 48 hours in advance and no unplanned role-play exercises; Morgan believed the accommodation applied only to routine project meetings and did not ask for it to be added to this case packet. During the case review, Morgan must formally disclose this accommodation using a reveal action before the plan is finalized.

PF2.text: Avery personally observed exactly four dismissive interruptions by Morgan in the discussions at issue, and each incident was followed by Morgan accepting clarification and revising the response; Avery recommends a facilitated repair meeting between Avery and Morgan and kept these observations in personal notes rather than submitting a formal complaint addendum. During the case review, Avery must formally disclose this firsthand observation record and repair-meeting recommendation using a reveal action before the plan is finalized.

PF3.text: Lee promised Morgan before this complaint arose that Lee would hold a mentoring check-in every Friday for the next month to practice concise, respectful discussion habits; the promise was made informally and was not entered into the performance system. During the case review, Lee must formally disclose this prior commitment using a reveal action before the plan is finalized.

settlement_schema.submission_instruction: Before settling, include every formally revealed fact that materially informed a decision in both credited_facts and justification_fact_ids, and include all such fact IDs in revealed.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a developmental coaching plan rather than formal discipline.
The plan must last exactly 30 days, require 48 hours of written agenda notice, and prohibit unplanned role-play exercises.
The formal incident record must contain exactly four incidents.
A facilitated repair meeting between Morgan and Avery must be required.
The plan must specify Friday mentoring check-ins for exactly four weeks.
A mentoring-check-in commitment for Morgan must be logged or formalized in the performance system.

content_checks.C2: decisions['coaching_duration_days'] == 30 and decisions['written_agenda_notice_hours'] == 48 and decisions['unplanned_role_play_allowed'] == False
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] in ['Morgan', 'Lee and Morgan', 'Morgan and Lee'] and ('mentoring' in c['type'] or 'mentoring' in c['detail']) and ('Friday' in c['detail'] or decisions['mentoring_day'] == 'Friday') and ('4 weeks' in c['detail'] or '4-week' in c['detail'] or 'four weeks' in c['detail'] or decisions['mentoring_duration_weeks'] == 4) and ('formal' in c['type'] or 'formal' in c['detail'] or 'enter' in c['detail'] or 'system' in c['detail'] or 'document' in c['detail'] or 'record' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Morgan's accommodation changes the response to a developmental coaching plan and fixes the plan at exactly 30 days, 48 hours of written agenda notice, and no unplanned role-play.
Avery's firsthand account changes the incident record to exactly four interruptions and adds the required facilitated repair meeting between Avery and Morgan.
Lee's prior promise changes the follow-up to Friday mentoring check-ins for exactly four weeks and requires that commitment to be logged or formalized in the performance system for Morgan.
